GUESS (@guess) opens a winter pop-up fronted by Stray Kids (@realstraykids) member Hyunjin in Jamsil tomorrow.

Hyunjin is a global ambassador for GUESS. The pop-up is set up as a gallery, showing visuals from the brand's winter 2026 campaign with Hyunjin alongside its denim pieces. The space is done in white and silver.

The brand says customers who make a purchase will get a limited-edition gift with unreleased visuals of Hyunjin, and visitors will get a pop-up-only pin badge, both while supplies last. There is also a station that laser-engraves a graphic of your choice onto denim.

Dates: Nov 23 (Mon) – Dec 6 (Sun)
Location: Lotte World Mall B1, Songpa-gu, Seoul
Reservations: Advance booking (walk-ins also accepted)
